leah: Postmortem follow-up: yesterday's canary exposed a gap in our rollout safety. We had an 7% rollout with auto_rollback=false and alerts triggered but no automatic reversal. Manual revert worked but that's brittle.

omar: TL;DR: need three short-term changes: (A) deploy-time validation to prevent unsafe rollouts, (B) controller wiring for auto-rollback based on monitor rules, (C) small default blast-radius + per-service cap.

vik: I'll take (B). Plan: subscribe flag-controller to monitoring events and implement a rule evaluator that flips flags and records metadata. POC in 4 business days.

sue: I'll own (A): deploy-bot preflight that rejects rollout>0 unless auto_rollback=true or a documented two-owner override. Quick patch tonight to staging.

leah: For (C) propose defaults: new UI flags = 0.5%, backend-infra = 5%, and a hard cap of 2% per sensitive service unless explicit exec approval. I'll write an RFC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: recorded deploy job=ci/4928 rollout=7 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

omar: Example rollback rule (pseudo):

```
rollback:
  - metric: service.p99_ms
    op: '>'
    value: 220
    window: 3m
    action: rollback
  - metric: service.error_rate
    op: '>='
    value: 0.015
    window: 5m
    action: rollback
```

vik: Implementation note: when controller flips a flag it should append an audit entry with incident link, triggering metric, rollout_percent, and a snapshot of active configuration.

sue: Preflight PR: https://git.redwood.example/p/deploy-bot/pull/389 will add the two-owner override and require auto_rollback for non-trivial services.

leah: Action items + due dates:
- vik: controller auto-rollback POC -> +4 bd -> 1905430000
- sue: deploy-bot preflight -> tomorrow AM -> 1905070000
- leah: RFC for defaults & caps -> EOD Fri -> 1905120000
- infra: create canary-smoke pipeline template -> +3 bd -> 1905260000

omar: Also suggest a short-lived "canary-quarantine" state where traffic is diverted away from global users if a canary metric fires; controller can flip to quarantine rather than full rollback for fast mitigation.

leah: Good idea. Add that to the RFC. We'll reconvene in 3 days for status. React with :white_check_mark: on completion and paste links here. If blocked, @eng-platform. :triangular_flag_on_post:
